 Order

By the present petition, the petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No. 399/2022 dated 28.08.2022,
registered at Police Station Pahar Ganj, for offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860, on the ground that the complainant does not wish to pursue any proceedings arising out of the present FIR.

2. It is seen that the FIR was registered on serious allegations that the petitioner established forceful physical relations after making the complainant drink alcohol and when the complainant started crying, the petitioner promised that he would marry her.
3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State submits that such serious allegations cannot be compounded only because the victim does not wish to pursue the case.
4. He seeks time to file reply.
